question: Will Anthropic have publicly released Claude Haiku 5.5 by October 16, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: Models overview and API release notes (latest Oct 5 2026) still show Haiku 4.5 as newest Haiku; no Haiku 5.5 ID. Anthropic said 'coming weeks' on Sep 22 and Sep 28; Sonnet 5.5 shipped 6 days after its announcement, and historically Haiku follows Sonnet by ~2-5 weeks (Haiku 4.5 ~16 days after Sonnet 4.5; Haiku 3.5 slipped ~2 weeks past a 'later this month' promise). ~10 days of window remain. Polymarket 'next Haiku (4.6+) by Oct 15' trades ~0.47-0.48 (thin, ~$6k volume; contract is broader on version and 1 day shorter), with 'by Oct 7' ~0.04 and 'by Oct 31' ~0.92, implying roughly even odds over this window. Shaded slightly below the market for thin liquidity and Anthropic's history of Haiku delays.

- Sep 22 2026 Opus 5.5 post: 'Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 will follow in the coming weeks.' Sep 28 Sonnet 5.5 post: Haiku 5.5 'will join the Claude 5.5 family in the coming weeks.' No date, price, or model ID published (qcode.cc tracker, orcarouter.ai, emergent.sh).

- A rumored 'Haiku 5' predicted by an X account for late Aug/early Sep 2026 never shipped (cellcog.ai). An early-Sep 2026 leak claimed Haiku was being discontinued; contradicted by the Sep 22 announcement (orcarouter.ai).
- Haiku had an ~11-month gap with no update (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026) while other tiers refreshed roughly every 6 months.
- Blog speculation (shattered.io) guesses 4-8 weeks after Sep 28; there is no official basis for this.
- Polymarket has a ladder of 'next Claude Haiku (4.6+) released by' contracts (Oct 7, Oct 15, Oct 31, Dec 31, plus single-day contracts); all thin (~$1.5k-$24k volume). They count any Haiku 4.6+ (broader than '5.5'), and the nearest deadline is Oct 15, one day earlier than this question's.

- Event window: now -> 2026-10-16 23:59 UTC; announcement 'coming weeks' clock started 2026-09-22 (~14.9 days elapsed; ~10.1 days remain, ~60% of the Sep 22->Oct 16 span elapsed).
- Searched for Bedrock/Vertex sightings, LMArena testing, or a dated Haiku 5.5 launch: found none beyond one unverified X post claiming Anthropic is 'testing haiku 5.5'.

As of Oct 5-6 the release notes and the models/deprecations pages still show no claude-haiku-5-5. Reference class: lag from the flagship launch to the Haiku launch within a family. Polymarket's Oct 31 contract trades at 0.92, so about half the probability falls after Oct 16. I land near the market at 0.45.
